li.label: a guest liked our room
li.description: A guest said our guest room was the best bed on the road. I helped make it.

li.label: a guest found fault
li.description: A guest let me know what they thought of where we put them. It wasn't much.

li.label: showed a guest around
li.description: I walked a guest round the colony. It looks better when you show it to someone.

li.label: a guest's stories of home
li.description: A guest told me all about where they come from. I could picture it.

li.label: sat up with a guest
li.description: A guest couldn't sleep, so we talked half the night.

li.label: a guest lent a hand
li.description: A guest pitched in with my work without being asked.

li.label: a good haggle
li.description: I haggled with a guest over a price. We both enjoyed it.

li.label: a guest's thanks
li.description: A guest thanked me for their stay, and meant it.

li.label: our guest is staying
li.description: The council let our guest stay on as one of us. I'm glad.

li.label: maybe another season
li.description: The council asked our guest to come back another time. Maybe they will.

li.label: welcome another time
li.description: They couldn't take me in this time, but they said I'd be welcome back.

li.label: they wouldn't have me
li.description: I asked to stay, and the colony said no.

li.label: my complaint was heard
li.description: I told them what was wrong with my stay, and they put it right.

li.label: brushed off
li.description: I complained about my stay and they told me to take it or leave it.

li.label: imperial manners
li.description: A visitor from the Empire showed me how things are done at court. I bowed wrong three times.

li.label: news from court
li.description: A visitor told me all the gossip from the Empire's court. Dukes, moons, scandals.

li.label: talk of the senate
li.description: A visitor explained how their republic governs itself. Our council looks simple next to it.

li.label: a mason's tricks
li.description: A visitor from the republic showed me how their builders set an arch. I want to try it.

li.label: a settler's tall tales
li.description: A settler told me stories about cattle drives and bandits. Half of them were lies, and all of them were good.

li.label: learned a rope trick
li.description: A settler taught me how ranchers handle animals. I caught a goat.

li.label: named in the dispatches
li.description: The Empire listed our colony among those who paid the levy in full. It's something, being named.

li.label: we handed over a deserter
li.description: That soldier came to us for help, and we sold them to the Empire. I keep thinking about the face.

li.label: a guest room worth the name
li.description: We have a guest room we can be proud of. The next travelers will sleep well.
